message.content: {"note_claim": "The video shows the 2022 Crimean Bridge explosion, not an attack on the King Fahd Causeway.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "The 2022 Crimean Bridge explosion occurred on 8 October 2022, at 6:07 a.m. A fire broke out on the Crimean Bridge as a result of an explosion of a bomb that had been loaded onto a truck.", "reason": "The page documents the 2022 Crimean Bridge explosion, with CCTV footage of it, but does not link the viral video to that event or mention the King Fahd Causeway, so it only indirectly supports the note."}

parsed.note_claim: The video shows the 2022 Crimean Bridge explosion, not an attack on the King Fahd Causeway.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: The 2022 Crimean Bridge explosion occurred on 8 October 2022, at 6:07 a.m. A fire broke out on the Crimean Bridge as a result of an explosion of a bomb that had been loaded onto a truck.
parsed.reason: The page documents the 2022 Crimean Bridge explosion, with CCTV footage of it, but does not link the viral video to that event or mention the King Fahd Causeway, so it only indirectly supports the note.
